estimate_flops_jax_function: estimate the FLOPs of a jitable JAX function by compiling it with XLA and running cost analysis
estimate_flops_with_static_args: estimate FLOPs for a JAX function that uses static_argnums to exclude certain arguments from tracing
profile_jax_computation_cost: profile the computational cost in FLOPs of any JAX function before running it on hardware
benchmark_jax_model_flops: benchmark the floating point operations of a JAX neural model forward pass
analyze_xla_hlo_cost: analyze the HLO module cost of a compiled JAX computation to get FLOP estimates
